checkpoints.root_cause: KeyValueEntry::make('signals') in ViewTaxonomyCandidateConceptLink.php requires flat string=>string values and calls htmlspecialchars() on each raw value. CanonicalConceptApplyService::apply() (line 229) stores signals = ['possible_existing_concepts' => [...]] for PROPOSE_NEW_CONCEPT candidates - a nested array value, not a scalar. PHP 8.2 throws TypeError on htmlspecialchars(array), even for an empty array. All 10 candidates from the Phase C run (ids 263-272) are PROPOSE_NEW_CONCEPT, so all 10 failed identically.
checkpoints.symptom_note: Incident report said HTTP 503. Verified origin status is actually 500 (nginx access log + user-supplied HAR, both independent of each other, same timestamps as the Laravel exception log). Cloudflare/browser-perceived 503 vs origin 500 - flagged, not silently corrected.

checkpoints.fix: Presentation-layer only: KeyValueEntry::make('signals') now uses ->state() to flatten any non-scalar value to JSON before Filament renders it. Does not change the shape of `signals` as stored in the database.

3_concurrency_safe_idempotency.mechanism: Postgres partial unique indexes + insertOrIgnore() (compiles to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) - the database arbitrates concurrent writes, not a check-then-act read in the application.
3_concurrency_safe_idempotency.taxonomy_candidate_concept_links: Had NO unique constraint before this task (confirmed by reading the code, not assumed). New migration 2026_09_28_165653_add_unique_constraints_to_taxonomy_candidate_concept_links adds two partial unique indexes: (suggested_term_id, suggested_concept_id) WHERE suggested_concept_id IS NOT NULL, and (suggested_term_id) WHERE suggested_concept_id IS NULL. Ran successfully against the shared Supabase instance (php artisan migrate:status confirms [53] Ran), which also proves no duplicate rows existed beforehand.
3_concurrency_safe_idempotency.taxonomy_concept_relations: Already had UNIQUE(source_concept_id, target_concept_id, relation_type) since table creation - no new migration needed, code adapted to rely on it via insertOrIgnore() instead of letting a violation abort the whole apply() transaction uncaught.
3_concurrency_safe_idempotency.rejection_history_preserved: Indexes are on the pair regardless of status - a prior rejected row still blocks a re-proposal, same semantics as before, nothing deleted.

4_stale_state_contract.mechanism: CanonicalConceptBuilderService::dryRunInputFingerprint() - conceptGraphFingerprint() (full content hash, unchanged) combined with tableVersionSignal() (COUNT+MAX(updated_at)) for taxonomy_terms, taxonomy_term_aliases, taxonomy_term_cpv_relations, taxonomy_term_embeddings, taxonomy_term_service_relations, taxonomy_term_source_bindings, taxonomy_settings, taxonomy_concept_relations.
4_stale_state_contract.cost_tradeoff: Full content hash of the ~9.7k-row taxonomy_term_cpv_relations table on every --apply would be expensive given documented Supabase latency - used the cheaper version-signal alternative the finding itself offered instead of forcing a full hash.
4_stale_state_contract.excluded_by_design: predicted_impact source tables (empresa_taxonomy_category, company_term_matches, etc.) - that field is always recomputed live at review time, never read from what was stored on the candidate, so it can never go stale.

5_protected_table_proof.counts_relabeled: Diagnostic only, documented as such in counts()'s docblock.
5_protected_table_proof.structural_verification: Read the full CanonicalConceptApplyService.php file - confirmed zero write paths (create/insertOrIgnore/update/delete) to taxonomy_term_concepts, taxonomy_canonical_concepts, or taxonomy_term_cpv_relations anywhere in the class.
5_protected_table_proof.content_fingerprint_added: protectedTableSignature() - full content hash (tableFingerprint()) for the 2 small graph tables + the cheap version signal (tableVersionSignal(), same mechanism as finding 4) for taxonomy_term_cpv_relations. Computed before/after inside apply()'s transaction, aborts on mismatch even if row counts are unchanged.

6_relation_approval_revalidation.real_gap_found: EditTaxonomyConceptRelation's $unchanged check only compared source/target/relation_type, not status - approving a relation (candidate -> approved) without touching its endpoints was treated as "no change" and skipped revalidation entirely. The pre-existing test suite had even encoded this as expected/passing behavior.
6_relation_approval_revalidation.fix_page_layer: Now revalidates whenever the submitted status is approved, regardless of whether endpoints changed. validateConceptRelationProposal() gained an optional excludeId parameter so the row being approved doesn't match itself as its own duplicate.
6_relation_approval_revalidation.fix_model_layer: TaxonomyConceptRelation::booted() adds a saving-event guard that runs the same revalidation for ANY entry point (Filament, tinker, a future API), not just this one page - defense in depth.
